data.summary: Created 4 visualizations showing model performance: scatter plot, crop comparison, residual analysis, and error distribution. All plots include legends and proper annotations.
data.task_answer: The Linear Regression model successfully predicts Mandi prices with high accuracy (R²=0.9988), but shows minor overprediction bias. The model's predictions align closely with actual values across most crops, though specific crops show larger discrepancies that warrant further investigation.
